items.html: And it is found that just as the coupling of Arich was through the inclusion of three NHY within three Hesed-Gevura-Tifferet, so ZA emerged included three within three, as I shall write below at length, with the help of God, which is the reason why Arich needed to gather his legs and include them within HGT as mentioned. And this Yesod of Arich is the shofar from which a voice comes out, included of three, which are fire, wind, and water, as mentioned above in this chapter regarding the verse "out of the depths I called upon Yah," for afterward they came out, from this Yesod called shofar, to AVI called Yah, and there they were corrected in the secret of the ibbur. And so we shall first explain how ZON were drawn in the secret of the ibbur within AVI.
